threshold = [0] * M
for i in range(M):
    threshold[i] = int(data[2 + N - 1 + N + i])

Q = int(data[2 + N - 1 + N + M])

    index += 3

# Build the tree
tree = [[] for _ in range(N)]
for i in range(1, N):
    tree[parent[i]].append(i)

# Calculate the contribution of each factory
contribution = [0] * N
def calculate_contribution(node, depth):
    contribution[node] = depth
    for child in tree[node]:
        calculate_contribution(child, depth + 1)
calculate_contribution(0, 0)

# Process each query
earnings = [0] * M
years = [float('inf')] * M
for year, (F, X, D) in enumerate(queries, start=1):
    current_node = F
    while current_node != -1:
        earnings[B[current_node]] += X
        if earnings[B[current_node]] >= threshold[B[current_node]]:
            years[B[current_node]] = min(years[B[current_node]], year)

        current_node = parent[current_node]
